g.text: Inside the I/Q adapter: reused arithmetic hardware

text.style: font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #586a80

g.text: One multiplier and accumulator compute one polyphase result at a time. The four output phases reuse the same datapath.

g.text: At a quarter-rate IF, the oscillator values are only 0, +1 and -1. Selecting I or

text.style: font-size: 14.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #26364b

g.text: Q and changing the sign performs the mixing step.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #65778a
font-size: 14.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #26364b

g.text: The shared MAC reduces arithmetic hardware. It requires multiple clocks for

text.style: font-size: 14.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #26364b

g.text: each sample and stalls when the downstream core cannot accept data.
